title: The Deep Extraction
author: Emrys Galloway
blurb: Elodie Fairweather, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
